symptom_signature.description: Automatic reactor trip (SCRAM) initiated by RPS channel 4 on high neutron flux signal from U1-NI-RPS-4A at 14:22:03. All four CRD banks inserted within 2.4 seconds. Post-trip review required to determine whether the trip was initiated by a genuine power excursion or a spurious instrument signal.

initial_assessment: Automatic trip on NI channel 4 high flux. Channels 1, 2, 3 did not respond. Single-channel trip — spurious signal or genuine single-channel exceedance under investigation. FCV-FW-3301 showed position deviation 45s before trip. CRD-2214 showed position step 10s after trip.
